answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph prices bulk fakes out. Each new agent posts 200 tokens as escrow and lists its referrals on a beacon ledger, locked for 20 epochs like an ember. Any peer may dispute an identity; a raven watcher checks the graph, and a star cluster from one sponsor marks the batch as clones. A held dispute slashes both deposits. One honest agent pays 200 once and gets it back; 100 fakes burn 20,000 tokens for nothing.
